s11-transactions-and-acid.query: BEGIN; UPDATE inventory SET available=0 WHERE id=1; ROLLBACK; SELECT id,available FROM inventory ORDER BY id;

s11-isolation-levels.query: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ; SELECT available FROM inventory WHERE id=1; ROLLBACK;

s11-mvcc-basics.query: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ; SELECT id,available FROM inventory ORDER BY id; ROLLBACK;

s11-locks.query: BEGIN; SELECT id FROM inventory ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; ROLLBACK;

s11-deadlocks.query: BEGIN; SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE id IN (1,2) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE; ROLLBACK;

s11-booking-concurrency.query: UPDATE inventory SET available=available-1 WHERE id=2 AND available>0 RETURNING id,available;

s11-constraints.query: UPDATE inventory SET available=-1 WHERE id=1;

s11-composite-indexes-and-column-order.query: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id=1 ORDER BY created_at,id;

s11-explain-and-explain-analyze.query: SELECT id,total FROM orders WHERE user_id=1 ORDER BY created_at,id;
